'''Twin Suns Station''' was the name given to the main building complex in the [[Twin Suns mining compound|mining compound]] run by the [[Twin Suns (pirates)|Twin Suns]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="TOR:QQ" />
